title: InstanSeg
description: Segment cell nuclei in 2D RGB brightfield histology images with InstanSeg brightfield_nuclei.

segment.title: Segment nuclei
segment.description: Run InstanSeg brightfield_nuclei (v0.1.1) on one 2D RGB TIFF, OME-TIFF or PNG image and return the calibrated instance label TIFF and per-nucleus morphometry CSV.

image.description: One bounded 2D RGB brightfield microscopy image (TIFF, OME-TIFF or PNG, up to 16 MP)

pixelSize.description: Physical pixel size in micrometres per pixel (omitted uses TIFF/OME-TIFF metadata up to 2 µm/px or native 0.5 µm/px)

seedThreshold.description: Minimum seediness local-maximum score to propose a nucleus (default 0.70)

maskThreshold.description: Pixel probability threshold for each nucleus mask (default 0.53)

overlapThreshold.description: Intersection-over-minimum-area threshold for merging overlapping seed masks (default 0.30)

tileSize.description: Tile size in pixels for overlap-tile inference on larger images (default 512)

backend.description: Requested inference backend; WebGPU failures fall back to WASM CPU.
